case_title: HEATHER DEBEST VS. THE CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISC

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-20-2025 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DEBEST, HEATHER RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT THE CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISC DBA SFMTA $750.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $750.00, GOVERNMENT CODE IMMUNITY INAPPLICABLE. THE BASIS OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM IS NOT A DISCRETIONARY DECISION BY A CITY EMPLOYEE, HER CLAIM IS BASED ON NEGLIGENCE. THE INSPECTOR MISREAD THE TIME STAMP ON THE MUNI PAYPASS PLAINTIFF PRODUCED ON HER CELL PHONNE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
